text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two shadows sprint across the turf,
cutting through the wind as if chasing each other's heat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The eyes of the girl called the "Emperor"――
flashed with an unmistakably sharp glint.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—!
...Kh, haha!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (Stop glaring like that! Aren't you supposed to be the saintly "Symboli Rudolf"?!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
ORAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And claiming victory in the year-end Grand Prix
—Sirius Symboli!!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *pant*, *wheeze*, *huff*...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has brought down the "Emperor" Symboli Rudolf
and magnificently ascended to the throne!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah, haah――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
......
...Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...See? I've gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I surpassed you.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: Someday, I'll surpass you! And when I do, I'll shine brighter than you, brighter than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
—Just you wait.
Someday, I'll show you just how strong I've become.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right.
...Thanks, Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
…………
...What a shame.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
However, yes――
...it was simply extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli claimed a brilliant victory in the Arima Kinen.
Her remarkable feat was widely covered in the media—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah~! Senpai was so crazy cool
that day, wasn't she~!!
Just remembering it makes me cry... *sniff*!

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, wasn't it?
...I need to do my best, too.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
She was aiming to race overseas, right?
Is she leaving soon? It's gonna be lonely around here.

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
According to rumors,
she managed to land a pretty massive sponsor.
Well, she has been performing amazingly, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In a flash, she became the Umamusume of the hour. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day to officially announce
the two-year overseas expedition plan had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Umamusume world is lagging behind the rest of the globe.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even though everyone knows it, the reason taking on overseas racing hasn't progressed,
despite all the various reasons—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: In any case, it's because there is no precedent.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"The return on investment is unclear.
People don't see the value in it.
That goes double for long-term expeditions."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The Eight Classic Races certainly have value. But with
a predetermined ceiling, their future is limited.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Talk about your dreams in an open world.
Don't go putting shackles on your own legs.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I will be the beacon that guides you all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Just chase after the brightest star—Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The previously silent venue—
was suddenly wrapped in thunderous applause.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ..."Come and catch me," huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The day a blue first-magnitude star shines across the skies of the world—
surely, it is not far off."
